<!--
A figure brought in with {{< embed >}} from another document. Its apa-note is
a chunk option, which the embedded output does not carry, so embednote.lua
reads it back out of the other document.

With notebook-view on, quarto puts a "Source:" link to the other document
under the figure. The note belongs to the figure and goes above the link.

A successful run gives the note once, under the figure, above the link and
before the text that follows it.
-->
